question: How much does a student membership in the Northwind Cycling Club cost?
expected_answer: $40 per year, with a valid student ID.

question: What happens if I renew my Northwind membership after March 31?
expected_answer: You pay a $15 reinstatement fee on top of the membership price.

question: What pace does the Green group ride at?
expected_answer: Moderate, averaging 23 to 27 km/h.

question: Is the Black group a no-drop ride?
expected_answer: No. Black is a drop ride; riders who can't hold the pace must find their own way home.

question: When do I need a rear light on a club ride?
expected_answer: For any ride that starts before 7:00 a.m.

question: How soon do I have to report a crash, and how?
expected_answer: Within 48 hours, to the club safety officer, using the online incident form.

question: When are Northwind rides cancelled because of weather?
expected_answer: When it is below -5 degrees Celsius at the start time or lightning is forecast.

question: How long is the Lakeshore Century and when is it held?
expected_answer: 160 km, on the second Saturday of September.

question: What do Northwind members get for volunteering?
expected_answer: Volunteering at least 4 hours per season is required of every member; members who meet it get a 20% discount at Spoke & Gear.

question: What is the usable capacity of the AB-200 battery?
My AB-200 shows error E07. What does it mean and how do I fix it?
expected_answer: A communication fault; restart the gateway by holding its button for 10 seconds.

question: Will the AB-200 charge when it's -5°C?
expected_answer: No. Charging is disabled below 0°C, although it can still discharge down to -10°C.

question: What backup reserve does the AB-200 keep in its default mode?
expected_answer: 20%, in Self-Powered mode (the default).

question: What does the AB-200 warranty cover?
expected_answer: 10 years or 6,000 full cycles, whichever comes first, with at least 70% of original capacity retained.

question: How many items can I borrow at once with an adult library card?
expected_answer: Up to 25 items.

question: What is the overdue fine for an adult book at Fern Valley library?
expected_answer: $0.25 per day, up to a maximum of $10 per item.

question: Can I take a library laptop home?
expected_answer: No. Laptops are loaned for 3 hours and can only be used inside the library building.

question: Is Fern Valley library open on Sundays?
expected_answer: No, it is closed on Sundays.

question: If I'm not a Fern Valley resident, how much would a library card plus a Standard Northwind membership cost per year in total?
expected_answer: $145 per year ($60 for the non-resident library card plus $85 for a Standard membership).

question: Which Northwind pace groups are no-drop rides, and how fast does each go?
expected_answer: Blue (18 to 22 km/h) and Green (23 to 27 km/h).

question: How much does the AB-200 battery cost?
expected_answer: Not stated in the documents.

expected_answer: Not stated in the documents.

history.question: What does error code E04 mean on the AB-200?
history.answer: E04 is an over-temperature error: output is reduced until the battery cools below 40°C.

expected_answer: Cell imbalance; contact Aurora support and don't restart the battery more than twice.

history.question: How long can I borrow a DVD from Fern Valley library?
history.answer: DVDs can be borrowed for 7 days.

expected_answer: Up to 2 times, unless someone has placed a hold on it.

question: How many people does it cover?

history.question: What does a Family membership cost at Northwind?
history.answer: A Family membership is $150 per year.

expected_answer: Up to four people living in the same household.
